bar.label: Run controls
bar.stale: The project changed after this run started. Restart to use the change.

limit.statements: The code ran too many steps without finishing a pass. Look for a loop that never ends.
limit.operations: One expression needed too many operations. Check the numbers it works on.
limit.memory: The code used more memory than the simulator allows.
limit.time: The run took too long and was stopped.

killed: The simulator stopped answering, so it was restarted. Your project is unchanged.
noDetail: The code could not be started.

diag.unknown-ground: The circuit has no usable ground. Connect a part to GND and run again.
diag.duplicate-part: Two parts share one id. Remove one of them and add it again.
diag.missing-net: A part pin points at a wire that does not exist. Reconnect that pin.
diag.unknown-part: A part in this project is not in the parts library.
diag.ambiguous-input-pin: An input is wired to two board pins at once. Connect it to one pin.
diag.netlist-too-large: The circuit has more parts than the simulator can run (2,000 at most).
diag.no-time-progress: The code ran without time moving forward. Look for a loop that never waits.
diag.event-queue-overflow: The circuit produced too many events at once, so the run stopped.
diag.output-contention: Two outputs drive one wire to opposite levels. Disconnect one of them.
diag.numeric-fault: The circuit solver hit a number it cannot use. Check the part values for zero or huge numbers.
diag.no-convergence: The circuit solver could not settle on a result. Check the wiring for a short or a loop.
diag.invalid-device-params: A part has a value its model cannot use. Check its settings.

serial.title: Serial output
serial.empty: Nothing printed yet. Run the project to see what the code sends.
serial.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying.
serial.placeholder: Type a line and press Enter

flow.hint: Wire colour shows volts. Dots show which way the current runs and how much.
flow.hintStill: Wire colour shows volts. Arrows show which way the current runs.

readout.none: Point at a wire or a part to read it.
